title: campanula elatines var. garganica
intro: Campanula elatines var. garganica, commonly known as Garganica, is a plant species within the family Campanulaceae. This flowering plant is known for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Campanula garganica include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which are said to help in alleviating symptoms of respiratory issues and improve overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of Campanula garganica include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties.
